svg.aria-label: Harness rules by signal class: differential CAN twisted as a pair with no termination on the stub; single-ended digital runs twisted signal with ground inside shielded LiYCY with the shield drained at the box only; low-level analog twisted with its return and kept 15 cm from the ignition; insulation by short adhesive heat-shrink at ends, cloth tape along the run, spiral wrap at pinch zones, ferrite clamps at the glands
svg.text: Fig. 13 — Harness rules by signal class (HI §3.4) and the anatomy of one shielded run
EMI sources: ignition coil / HT lead, regulator-rectifier, starter cable, fuel pump and injector wiring. Magnetic coupling falls steeply with distance: a rear box is quieter.

g.text: Differential bus — CAN_H / CAN_L
Twist H+L tightly, ~30–40 twists/m.
Unshielded FLRY-B 0.35–0.50 mm² is enough.
120 Ω only at the platform-bus ends;
never on the < 50 cm DLC stub.
Length is not the enemy: the error counters
and can_bus_off_count tell you if pickup exists.
Single-ended digital — SPI / I2C / UART / WS2812B
NEVER twist SCL+SDA, SCK+MOSI or TX+RX together
(capacitive cross-talk). Instead:
pair 1 = Signal + GND · pair 2 = VCC + GND
LiYCY 4×0.22 shielded; the M4 IMU SPI link needs
6 or 8 cores. Shield → GND at the Main Box ONLY.
I2C ≤ ~30 cm or a PCA9615 differential extender;
2.2–4.7 kΩ pull-ups at the controller (proposal).
WS2812B: 5 V buffer + 330 Ω, Data+GND twisted,
slack through the head stock, desk test at length.
Low-level analog — thermocouple / NTC / Hall
K-type EGT (µV/°C), M12 sump NTC, 10 k radiator NTC,
ACS758 analog out.
Twist Signal + Signal_Return (AGND) tightly.
MAX31856 cold junction close to the braid exit.
≥ 15 cm from the ignition coil and HT lead.
5–7 mm snap-on ferrites on the engine-bay ADXL345,
EGT and spark-clip cables right before the PG7.
AGND meets GND once, at the H755 analog reference.

svg.text: Anatomy of one shielded sensor run (sensor box → Main Box)
LiYCY braided shield · pairs inside · Tesa 51608 cloth tape 50 % overlap along the run (stays flexible, damps rattle, 105–150 °C)
PE spiral wrap / split loom 6–8 mm
only at pinch zones: head stock, swingarm pivot, pass-throughs

g.text: • Full-length heat-shrink (stiffens, transfers vibration into solder joints, traps condensation). • Chassis as a ground return. • A second ground path for the same unit.
• Cables near the plug lead, regulator or starter cable. • Modules soldered directly into perfboard (socket them). • Any cable without a label at both ends.
Keep the wiring diagram with hardware-integration.md; record cable lengths actually used in §10 (DLC run, IMU runs, ring run).
